notes: *Yea* is added because no conjunction morpheme stands before אַרְבַּע at all — rule 14's closing sentences govern. Contrast PRO.30.18 and PRO.30.29, where a waw is written and takes the same word.
הֵנָּה is the unrendered occurrence of the tripartite clause's subject under rules 20 and 22; the presentative *There are* joins the numeral, which is the predicate.
The *hath* of *The horseleach hath two daughters* sits on the possessive לְ under rule 43; MACULA segments no article there, so the *The* is a supplied determiner joining the noun under rule 15.
